# Brendan Heussler

> Independent software consultant in San Diego, California. Full-stack engineer who
> turns complicated systems into products that feel simple, fast, and dependable.

Available for product engineering, scalable web platforms, AI and automation, and
technical strategy. Work spans high-traffic customer experiences at Intuit through to
focused independent products. Enquiries go through the contact form on the site; there
is no published email address or phone number.

## Professional work

- [TurboTax local stores and experts](https://turbotax.intuit.com/local-tax-offices/ny/new-york/d51a4afe6691489aa78ee8793a6bc278/): Scalable local discovery and profile infrastructure for hundreds of TurboTax stores and thousands of expert pages, connecting customers with trusted tax help nearby. The link is one representative live location.
- [Certified Pickleball Player](https://www.certifiedpickleballplayer.com/): A player platform combining verified credentials, personalized gear, community discovery, and AI-powered match analysis.

## Personal work

- [Abraham](https://builtbybrendan.com/#contact): A trading algorithm that beats the S&P 500 in historical testing, backed by reproducible research and disciplined risk controls. The historical-testing qualifier is load-bearing: this is a backtested result, not a claim about live or future returns. There is no public product page — enquiries go through the contact form.
- [GuiltySpark](https://guiltyspark.builtbybrendan.com/): A log monitor and autonomous engineering tool that watches production logs, finds bugs in context, and turns incidents into tested fixes.
